annotations.category_path: Average Monthly Federal Benefit on December 31 (Dollars) / Unlabeled value (row 30)
annotations.variable_note: The Social Security Administration (SSA) is required to pay Supplemental Security Income payments on the first day of the month. If the first day of the month occurs on a holiday or a weekend, SSA will instead make the payments on the preceding business day. As a result, in any given fiscal year there may be 11, 12, or 13 payments.
